comment: A `paths` target is a file path, not a package specifier, so the one exports subpath
(`node:fs/promises`) has to name its declaration file.
The site is bundled by `gjsify build`, never by `tsc` — this config exists only for
`npm run check`. `paths` points the `node:` specifiers at the gjsify shims the bundle
actually uses, which is closer to the truth on GJS than `@types/node` would be.
`gi://` modules are declared by `@girs/*/ambient`, referenced from `build/gi-ambient.d.ts`.
